note: Cost columns over the frozen Analysis substrate (#404). The journey set is the substrate's, verbatim and unmodified (Amendment 1). Every number here is produced by this script; nothing is recalled.

measurement.gateCountBasis: a station is a gate iff authorizationBoundary in {human-gate, platform-gate} OR bindingHardness in {mechanical, platform-enforced}; human interactions are counted separately as authorizationBoundary == human-gate; standing-authorization is counted separately again

highTraversal.rule: attributedCommits >= median of the attributable population

gateDensityUpper.rule: upper quartile of gateDensity over all 70 journeys

gateDensityLower.rule: lower quartile of gateDensity over all 70 journeys
